framework.error.bad_request.detail.label: The request could not be processed.

framework.error.forbidden.detail.label: You do not have permission to view this page.

framework.error.form.label: Please fix the errors below
framework.error.form.comment: Summary toast shown when a submitted form fails validation.

framework.error.home.label: Go home
framework.error.home.comment: Link out of an error page, back to the site root.

framework.error.internal.detail.label: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
framework.error.internal.detail.comment: Body of the 500 error page; never leaks the underlying error.

framework.error.not_found.detail.label: The page you were looking for does not exist.

ui.a11y.apply.label: Apply
ui.a11y.apply.comment: Submit button on a preference form that posts a choice.

ui.a11y.chart.generic.label: Chart.
ui.a11y.chart.generic.comment: Fallback name for a keyboard-operable chart the caller did not name.

ui.a11y.chart.keys.label: Use the arrow keys to step through it, Home and End for the ends, Escape to leave.
ui.a11y.chart.keys.comment: Key hint appended to every keyboard-operable chart name.

ui.a11y.close.label: Close
ui.a11y.close.comment: Accessible name for the X button that closes a modal or drawer.

ui.a11y.composer.label: Message
ui.a11y.composer.comment: Fallback accessible name for the chat composer's text box.

ui.a11y.delta.down.label: down
ui.a11y.delta.down.comment: Screen-reader label for a falling stat delta.

ui.a11y.delta.none.label: no change
ui.a11y.delta.none.comment: Screen-reader label for a flat stat delta.

ui.a11y.delta.up.label: up
ui.a11y.delta.up.comment: Screen-reader label for a rising stat delta, so the arrow's meaning does not depend on color.

ui.a11y.dismiss.label: Dismiss
ui.a11y.dismiss.comment: Accessible name for the X button that removes an alert or toast.

ui.a11y.live.pause.label: Pause updates
ui.a11y.live.pause.comment: Control that stops server-pushed updates (WCAG 2.2.2). Visible text and accessible name.

ui.a11y.live.pause_named.label: Pause %s updates
ui.a11y.live.pause_named.comment: Pause control naming what updates. %s is the caller's label, e.g. "Board".

ui.a11y.live.paused.label: Updates are paused.
ui.a11y.live.paused.comment: Status line shown in place of the stream while updates are paused.

ui.a11y.live.resume_named.label: Resume %s updates
ui.a11y.live.resume_named.comment: Resume control naming what updates. %s is the caller's label.

ui.a11y.loading.label: Loading
ui.a11y.loading.comment: Announced by a spinner and by a deferred section still waiting for its content.

ui.a11y.md.bold.label: Bold
ui.a11y.md.bold.comment: Markdown toolbar: wrap the selection in bold.

ui.a11y.md.code.label: Code
ui.a11y.md.code.comment: Markdown toolbar: wrap the selection as code.

ui.a11y.md.h2.label: Heading
ui.a11y.md.h2.comment: Markdown toolbar: turn the current line into a heading.

ui.a11y.md.image.label: Insert image
ui.a11y.md.image.comment: Markdown toolbar: upload an image and insert its Markdown.

ui.a11y.md.italic.label: Italic
ui.a11y.md.italic.comment: Markdown toolbar: wrap the selection in italic.

ui.a11y.md.link.label: Link
ui.a11y.md.link.comment: Markdown toolbar: turn the selection into a link.

ui.a11y.md.ol.label: Numbered list
ui.a11y.md.ol.comment: Markdown toolbar: prefix the selection as a numbered list.

ui.a11y.md.preview.label: Preview
ui.a11y.md.preview.comment: Accessible name of the Markdown editor live-preview pane.

ui.a11y.md.quote.label: Quote
ui.a11y.md.quote.comment: Markdown toolbar: prefix the selection as a block quote.

ui.a11y.md.source.label: Markdown
ui.a11y.md.source.comment: Fallback accessible name of the Markdown editor textarea.

ui.a11y.md.toolbar.label: Formatting
ui.a11y.md.toolbar.comment: Accessible name of the Markdown editor toolbar.

ui.a11y.md.ul.label: Bulleted list
ui.a11y.md.ul.comment: Markdown toolbar: prefix the selection as a bulleted list.

ui.a11y.md.video.label: Insert video
ui.a11y.md.video.comment: Markdown toolbar: upload a video via tus and insert its fence.

ui.a11y.menu.label: Menu
ui.a11y.menu.comment: Fallback accessible name for a menu trigger that shows only a caret.

ui.a11y.more.label: More
ui.a11y.more.comment: Fallback accessible name for a popover trigger with no label of its own.

ui.a11y.nav.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
ui.a11y.nav.breadcrumb.comment: Name of the ancestry-trail navigation landmark.

ui.a11y.nav.next.label: Next
ui.a11y.nav.next.comment: Visible text and accessible name of the pagination forward link. Keep it short: it is rendered, not only announced.

ui.a11y.nav.page.label: Page %d
ui.a11y.nav.page.comment: Accessible name of a numbered pagination link. %d is the page number.

ui.a11y.nav.pagination.label: Pagination
ui.a11y.nav.pagination.comment: Name of the page-number navigation landmark.

ui.a11y.nav.prev.label: Previous
ui.a11y.nav.prev.comment: Visible text and accessible name of the pagination back link. Keep it short: it is rendered, not only announced.

ui.a11y.nav.primary.label: Primary
ui.a11y.nav.primary.comment: Name of the main navigation landmark. Screen readers append "navigation", so do not repeat the word.

ui.a11y.nav.sidebar.label: Sidebar
ui.a11y.nav.sidebar.comment: Name of the side navigation landmark. Screen readers append "navigation".

ui.a11y.new_tab.label: (opens in a new tab)
ui.a11y.new_tab.comment: Screen-reader-only suffix on a link that leaves the page for a new tab.

ui.a11y.notifications.label: Notifications
ui.a11y.notifications.comment: Name of the page's live region, where status messages and toasts arrive.

ui.a11y.progress.label: Progress
ui.a11y.progress.comment: Fallback accessible name for a progress bar the caller did not name.

ui.a11y.required.label: required
ui.a11y.required.comment: Appended to a form field's label when the field must be filled in.

ui.a11y.scheme.auto.label: Match system
ui.a11y.scheme.auto.comment: The colour-scheme choice that defers to the operating system. The default, and the state a visitor needs a way back to.

ui.a11y.scheme.legend.label: Colour scheme
ui.a11y.scheme.legend.comment: Legend for the light/dark control's radio group.

ui.a11y.send.label: Send
ui.a11y.send.comment: Accessible name for the send button on a chat composer.

ui.a11y.skip_to_content.label: Skip to content
ui.a11y.skip_to_content.comment: The bypass-blocks link: the first thing a keyboard reaches on every page.

ui.a11y.sort.asc.label: %s, sorted ascending
ui.a11y.sort.asc.comment: Accessible name of a table header sorted ascending. %s is the column heading.

ui.a11y.sort.desc.label: %s, sorted descending
ui.a11y.sort.desc.comment: Accessible name of a table header sorted descending. %s is the column heading.

ui.a11y.sort.none.label: sort by %s
ui.a11y.sort.none.comment: Accessible name of an unsorted sortable table header. %s is the column heading.

ui.auth.choose.label: Sign in or create an account
ui.auth.choose.comment: Accessible name of the sign-in dialog's login/register switcher.

ui.auth.email_optional.label: Email (optional)
ui.auth.email_optional.comment: Optional email field label in the create-account form.

ui.auth.login.label: Log in
ui.auth.login.comment: Switcher label and submit button of the sign-in form.

ui.auth.password.label: Password
ui.auth.password.comment: Password field label in the sign-in dialog.

ui.auth.register.label: Register
ui.auth.register.comment: Switcher label for the create-account form.

ui.auth.register_submit.label: Create account
ui.auth.register_submit.comment: Submit button of the create-account form.

ui.auth.terms_accept.label: I am 18+ and accept the terms
ui.auth.terms_accept.comment: Terms checkbox in the create-account form.

ui.auth.terms_read.label: Read the terms
ui.auth.terms_read.comment: Link to the terms document from the create-account form.

ui.auth.username.label: Username
ui.auth.username.comment: Username field label in the sign-in dialog.

ui.auth.welcome.label: Welcome
ui.auth.welcome.comment: Default title of the sign-in dialog.

ui.confirm.cancel.label: Cancel
ui.confirm.cancel.comment: Label of the dialog's cancel button, which is the focused control on open.

ui.confirm.confirm.label: Confirm
ui.confirm.confirm.comment: Fallback label of the destructive button. Callers should name the verb instead.

ui.confirm.title.label: Are you sure?
ui.confirm.title.comment: Fallback title of the destructive-action dialog when the caller gives none.

ui.consent.allow.label: Allow optional
ui.consent.allow.comment: Banner button that records yes for optional cookie categories.

ui.consent.always_on.label: Always on
ui.consent.always_on.comment: Badge on a necessary cookie category that cannot be switched off.

ui.consent.body.label: We use necessary cookies to run the site. Optional cookies stay off until you allow them.
ui.consent.body.comment: Body copy of the first-visit cookie banner.

ui.consent.category.label: Category
ui.consent.category.comment: Fallback name for a cookie category the caller did not label.

ui.consent.cookies.label: Cookie settings
ui.consent.cookies.comment: Footer link or button that reopens the cookie banner or goes to /cookies.

ui.consent.customize.label: Customize
ui.consent.customize.comment: Banner control that opens the cookie preference list.

ui.consent.manager_lead.label: Necessary cookies run the site. Everything else is off until you allow it.
ui.consent.manager_lead.comment: Standfirst under the cookie preference manager heading.

ui.consent.manager_title.label: Cookie preferences
ui.consent.manager_title.comment: Heading of the /cookies category list. Also the region's accessible name.

ui.consent.necessary.label: Necessary only
ui.consent.necessary.comment: Banner button that records no for optional categories, and the name of the always-on category in the manager.

ui.consent.necessary_help.label: Session, security, and this preference. Always on.
ui.consent.necessary_help.comment: Description of the necessary cookie category in the manager.

ui.consent.save.label: Save preferences
ui.consent.save.comment: Submit button on the cookie preference manager.

ui.consent.title.label: Cookies
ui.consent.title.comment: Title of the first-visit cookie banner. Also the region's accessible name.
